english: Practical jokes could positively reduce some people to tears sometimes.
She could positively get into a panic when unforeseen changes happen.
You can console yourself that you could positively make a quick recovery.
Taking the cramped living conditions into account, the family decided to find a bigger home.
It seems that her kitchen was small and cramped.
It was beyond me how they managed to fit so many people into such a cramped meeting room.
The stuffy classroom made it difficult for the teacher to capture the attention of the students.
They opened the windows in the stuffy room so that fresh air could come in.
He went to great lengths to prove that the stuffy office environment was negatively affecting his productivity.
My job can be so monotonous sometimes, for I do the same tasks over and over again every day.
His eyes lit up at the mere mention of a new adventure, as he was so eager to escape the monotonous task.
The drummer's rhythm was so captivating that the entire audience couldn't help dancing.
It has long been known that finding the rhythm in the music and moving accordingly is very important in dancing.
It strikes me as odd that she kept clicking her pen nervously during the meeting.
As the meeting drew to a close, the participants clicked their pens shut and left the room.
The sound of high heels clicking on the floor woke me up at midnight, which made my hair stand on end.
The waves crashing against the shore created a monotonous rhythm, which lulled me to sleep.
The sound of the rain lulled me to sleep in the process of reading a monotonous book.
The calming music in the background was supposed to lull me to sleep, but my mind was still conscious.
It’s true that sleep came in snatches last night, but I still felt relaxed today.
I underestimated how difficult it would be to get a sleeper before the Chinese Spring Festival.
It’s silly of me to get a sleeper for such a short trip.
He had to overcome a lot of obstacles to get a sleeper.
All of a sudden, she started fumbling through her purse to find her phone as it rang loudly in the quiet room.
He stopped to fumble with the lock on the door, trying to open it in the dark.
The sad truth is that the student who fumbled through his notes during the exam failed to find the answer he needed.
The documents are now available for inspection.
The equipment is being prepared for inspection before it can be used.
There was a chance that the product would be chosen for inspection.
It is inevitably heartbreaking to be separated from loved ones during long periods of travel.
It is inevitably important to insure your valuable possessions against theft.
The tour guide conducted us to our destination.
I have developed an unshakable faith in reaching my destination.
With determination, she edged her way through obstacles to reach her destination.
I felt exhausted from rigging up the stage equipment for the concert.
We were exhausted from sweeping up the leaves in the yard.
He was exhausted from studying for his exams all night.
There are still many tasks that remain to be done before the motorway construction project is complete.
I wish there were more rest areas along the motorway for drivers to take breaks during long journeys.
The workers had to haul the damaged car out of the motorway after the accident.
We had to pay the premium to take our car on the ferry to the island.
The cat was perched on the edge of the ferry, curiously watching the waves below.
As the storm approached, the passengers on the ferry looked on anxiously, hoping for a safe journey.
Taking part in activities like dance lessons or cooking classes during the cruise is a standard practice.
Let's plan to go on a cruise for our next vacation.
I can't wait to go on a cruise with my friends and relax on the deck while watching the sunset.
There is no doubt that the luxury hotel provided a civilized atmosphere.
It has long been known that China is a highly civilized country.
It is unacceptable to litter everywhere in a civilized society.
The children were excited to find a spacious room where they could run wild and play freely.
She switched on all the lights in the spacious room.
The basketball rebounded off the walls of the spacious gym.
I had the privilege of going on a cruise, but unfortunately, I couldn't enjoy it as I was seasick the entire time.
It has never been explained why some people are more likely to get seasick than others.
The ship swerved to avoid a coming boat, which caused many passengers to feel seasick.
To his dismay, she refused to be intimidated by his threats.
He never seems to be intimidated by anything.
I can’t conceal the fact that I was intimidated by the big occasion.
She was intimidated by what she saw on the promontory.
Watching a horror movie has the disadvantage of causing nightmares.
Driving at a fantastic speed has the disadvantage of easily causing accidents.
It has long been known that working late hours has the disadvantages of affecting your health.
Leading an exhilarating life can be incredibly fulfilling.
We’ve just got some exhilarating news that the students would be rewarded with a scholarship.
My first parachute jump, which I travelled miles to experience, was extremely exhilarating.
She is staring at an escapist who is reading science fiction novels.
It is clear that the beach attracts many escapists who seek relaxation and a break from their daily routine.
She sipped her tea while squinting at the small print in the book.
Sarah insisted that we should sip the wine slowly to fully appreciate its flavor.
He was anxious to sip the exotic cocktail at the bar.
I pestered my mother to open a bottle of champagne for celebration.
Her sister reprimanded her for drinking too much champagne.
He presented me with a bottle of champagne.
In the suburbs, unexpected refinement can be found in the gardens and architecture.
The new edition of the book includes a few refinements based on reader feedback.
There is always hope that unexpected refinement will emerge.
Few things could be more impressive than the breathtaking sunset over a lake surrounded by mountains.
They were amazed to see the breathtaking view at the bottom of the valley.
The hikers discovered a breathtaking waterfall by chance.
Watching the eagle soar high in the sky, I wish to have the same freedom one day.
As the hot air balloon soared above the city, I presumed that we would have a breathtaking view from up there.
I often have the impulse to soar high above the city and escape from the world below.
It seems odd that he could effortlessly play a complex piece of song on the piano.
As a nature lover, she goes into raptures every time she explores a beautiful landscape.
She took out her camera to capture the breathtaking landscape.
It astounded me that although she has worked all day, she still looks fresh.
However hard I worked, I would always be fresh and relaxed in the early morning the next day.
She emerged from the long flight looking surprisingly fresh and uncrumpled.
After taking a short walk in the park, I felt fresh and uncrumpled.
It is incredible to me that the athlete crossed the finish line, still looking fresh and uncrumpled.
Scientists claim they have succeeded in finding a cure for cancer.
How did you manage to persuade him?
How do you manage to stay so slim?
We somehow managed to persuade him.
I don’t know how I’ll manage to do it, but I’ll be there.
I went for a hike and waded across a river, hoping it would take my mind off the work.
She made a claim for compensation to help take her mind off the pain and trauma.
He decided to make a descent into the cave to explore its mysteries and take his mind off the recent breakup.
It is not uncommon to hear that students’ concentration in class comes in snatches.
During the camping trip, they had to make do with limited supplies, resulting in sleep coming in snatches.
There is a definite relation between interrupted sleep and dreams coming in snatches.
She fumbled to answer her phone while waiting for the red light.
She fumbled to find her notes while giving a presentation, which reduced her to tears in front of her colleagues.
She fumbled to find her keys at the bottom of her bag.
More often than not, I can't help crying when I watch a heartwarming movie.
By comparison, only two of the five men were acquainted with the suspect.
By comparison, only the newest evidence presented in court will help to prove his innocence.
Neither will you have an opportunity to stretch your legs.
It was not until the end of the journey that I finally found an opportunity to stretch my legs.
We need to devise ways of hauling the heavy boxes off the truck.
We need to devise ways of recovering the cost of the new equipment.
In order to solve the mystery, the detective had to devise ways of connecting the dots between the seemingly unrelated clues.
They are under the illusion that they can now settle back to enjoy a friendly supper.
Everyone seem to have settled back and started to relax.
As a special treat, she asked me to settle back and enjoy the show.
With the advent of computer technology, people can easily keep themselves occupied with endless online games and social media platforms.
He plotted to steal the jewels and keep the detective occupied with false information.
A series of books kept the children occupied with adventure.
After receiving proper medical care and attention, the stray dogs finally recovered from their illness.
The therapy served as a prelude to the patient's journey to recover from their painful experience.

grammar.title: 句式观察 · 情态动词
grammar.note: 原句含有情态动词。注意其后动词的形式，并结合语境理解能力、许可、必要性或推测等含义。
grammar.example: Practical jokes could positively reduce some people to tears sometimes.
